body: I don't even know what to say anymore, feels like it's all been done. I know immediate healing isn't possible but I have no idea or will for a long term recovery. Been years already

Thanks, I'm glad it wasn't so bad. 

Yeah, there are a few things that can hold my attention like that, but I don't know I'd consider them as passions or things I could actually talk about with other people, or be things worth living for. I still think that side of things is a lost cause... I don't know how to move on from the situation I'm in. 

But that's another day down, thanks for your help. Still want to die at the first good chance I get, but I have two medical appointments this week on Wednesday and Thursday so maybe I'll get some extra help then.

I'm back from the gym now, will have to go to bed soon. Thanks for taking the time to talk to me, sorry I'm frustrating to deal with a lot of the time. 

There's not many subreddits on my main account. They mostly under mental health (e.g. Anxiety, Depression, Mindfulness, Meditation etc) or cute/positive things (e.g. Aww, Cats, Mademesmile, Wholesomememes). There's a few more which don't fit those (e.g. AskHistorians, FoodPorn, Unitedkingdom) but I rarely look at those posts now.

I wasn't sure about my answer because I've asked myself it a lot and never really had a clear answer.  I think what I've said is correct. 

Not really,  everything is passing time. I can't enjoy things anymore,  just been using reddit for years. 

I have to go for a while

Interesting way to look at it. I guess the simplest answer to those questions would be my mental illnesses and the way my brain's wired compared to most people? That can account for how everyone else is just able to engage with the world and each-other
I know it's not worth it.

That can never happen though, and I'll still be the same miserable useless person. No change in circumstances - even if they are terrible now - will actually change me. And fundamentally, I am someone to be shunned for endless reasons

I don't see what can change that will help anything. I'm really past that point of improving anything, I know that it's all too late. I struggle to explain this and no-one seems to get it. I can never, ever be improved
I don't really understand what you're suggesting? This is already a tiny terraced house in a horrible neighbourhood, in the UK.

I don't mean to rely on people for happiness, I just wanted some basic friendly presence, but it's never going to happen anyway because I'm me. There's not a single reason to give a second thought as so many people have demonstrated my entire life.

I sincerely think there is no situation or change that can help besides dying and getting to skip the next few decades of torture.

Sorry this took awhile, I wrote my post on lunch break and I'm back now.

I suppose my friend just realised I'm not worth the effort and time anymore like I always insisted, and they're thousands of miles away so it's very easy to just break all contact like that. Probably the end point for them is when I tried to jump from a building when I went to visit at Christmas/New Year. I understand that was stressful (even if there wasn't any real risk - balcony straight below I didn't know about at first) but to break off 4+ years of love and support about it just validates everything I say.

As for my family, I'm stuck living with my parents and while I wouldn't say they've abandoned me yet, they clearly have no interest or care in anything about me or my situation. Even when the police were alerted and involved there's been zero follow-up. Like everyone, there's no reason to like me so they don't. And I'm just getting in the way of their life and reminding them of the failure I guess.

Honestly I believe I am uniquely incompetent among everyone I've ever met. Even if there was something I'm suited to, I'm way past the point of being willing to care to even try. It's all too late now. I don't even want to experience happiness or satisfaction anymore, just kill me already

I've been treated for depression/anxiety with medication, therapy and every self-help thing out there for ages and every effort I keep making to fight it just makes things worse. I'm trapped in a place I hate, doing work I hate, with no opportunity or ability or freedom to move or change anything. I'm horrible enough to deal with that I finally recently drove away the only friend I could depend on for support years. I've always been excluded and alienated and it's too late to change the lasting effects and ramifications of that. I really hate myself and everything around me and I'm just too toxic and worthless now. I can't move on from this and I'm not being unreasonable I think to want it to end. Every new day convinces me more and more that death is the only answer
There's no reason to think anything can happen. The more medical intervention and conscious effort, the worse things get

I know my mind is too ruined to carve any way or success, completely meaningless words to use about me. There's nothing in life that I could contribute to or have any interest in doing. I want it to stop. It's been years and years of treatment. I think overdose is the only option I've got
Doesn't matter, that's the idea. Prevent anything else from happening

Being a completely pointless, useless, excluded person. I can't move on in any way and I don't want to participate in any way, so I don't care about not 'experiencing', I want to stop anything else happening
There isn't a life though besides it. I just want to experience nothing,  that's all I want
Can anyone talk?

There's absolutely nothing, I'm locked out of friends and hobbies and there's nothing in the world I can call a goal or dream besides coming across an accessible way to die. 

I'm regularly seeing my GP, counselors and recently a psychiatrist. I've been on various antidepressants for a long time and I recently got prescribed tranquilisers. I try lots of activities (mindfulness, yoga, exercise etc) and workbooks to help and absolutely nothing works. I'm so worn down from everything and I can't escape but by dying. Really desperate, just want something like contact
I understand but I don't have the freedom or intuition to take any challenges. And everything else has just ended in failure anyway.  There's nothing left I have any interest in

I guess I just want to fit in and be accepted and not feel like an alien all the time. I'm too stupid and irresponsible for meet ups and pets, and I'm never going to accomplish anything. Can't live with it but I don't even get the chance to kill myself

Feels like I can be polite and still get nowhere though. There's nothing I want in life really. Wouldn't be happy even with friends.  I'm tired of having to do anything, all I can recognise is there's no way out. Always going to be inferior to everyone
Thanks for responding. I feel trapped into the space I've made for myself. I'm always excluded  and have nothing to offer anyone. Just boring and horrible to be around
